top_signals.title: Brittany Ferries Ends Live Irish Calf Exports
top_signals.summary: On September 1, Brittany Ferries stopped transporting live farm animals including unweaned calves.The move marks another milestone in a campaign by NGOs to end long-distance live transport and ensure animal welfare legislation is effectively enforced.
